description: Regionales Raumordnungsprogramm 2020 Beikarte Windenergie Landkreis Rotenburg (Wümme) is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. Legally binding regional planning programme of the district of Rotenburg (Wümme) in drawings. The Regional Spatial Planning Programme is developed from the Regional Spatial Planning Programme (LROP) 2017 and determines the desired spatial and structural development of the planning area, GDI-NI, GDI-MRH. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Regional spatial planning programme 2020 Beikarte Windenergie Landkreis Rotenburg (Wümme)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include GDIMRH, Landesplanung, Raumordnung, inspireidentifiziert, Raumplanung, Raumstruktur. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
